title: ServiceManifest
description: Strict declarative manifest for generating a service from domain entities, relationships, finite-state lifecycles, business rules, workflows, and authorization policies. The schema defines the structural contract; semantic cross-reference validation such as entity references, workflow-step dependencies, and expression correctness must additionally be performed by the manifest generator or validator.

version.description: Semantic version of the manifest itself.

service_name.description: Canonical snake_case identifier of the service being generated.

entities.description: Persistent or domain entities required to represent the supplied domain and workflows. Do not add speculative entities that are not required by the source specification.

business_rules.description: Domain invariants, validations, and business constraints.

workflows.description: Declarative business workflows composed of ordered or dependency-linked steps.

policies.description: Authorization policies defining which roles may perform which actions and, where applicable, which claims are required.

type.description: Supported primitive/domain storage type. This vocabulary is intentionally closed.

primary_key.description: Whether this attribute is part of the entity's primary key.

nullable.description: Whether the attribute may contain a null value.

unique.description: Whether values of this attribute must be unique within the entity.

indexed.description: Whether the attribute should be indexed for persistence/query purposes.

name.description: Canonical snake_case relationship name from the source entity to the target entity.

target_entity.description: Name of the target entity. The referenced entity must exist in the manifest.

cardinality.description: Relationship cardinality from the source entity to the target entity. 1:1 means one source instance relates to one target instance; 1:N means one source instance relates to many target instances; N:M means many source instances relate to many target instances.

foreign_key.description: Optional attribute on the source entity that stores the foreign-key identifier implementing the relationship. The referenced attribute must exist when this property is supplied.

trigger.description: Snake_case trigger that causes the state transition.

source_state.description: State from which the transition is permitted.

guards.description: Semantic guard expressions or named domain conditions that must hold before the transition occurs.

state_attribute.description: Attribute on the owning entity containing the current lifecycle state.

initial_state.description: Initial state assigned when the entity is created.

states.description: Complete set of lifecycle states supported by the entity.

transitions.description: Permitted state transitions. Every source_state and target_state must exist in states.

class_name.description: Explicit PascalCase Python class name used by FSM and Rule template generators.

relationships.description: Relationships from this entity to other domain entities.

fsm.description: Optional finite-state machine describing the entity lifecycle.

priority.description: Priority order used to sequence rule evaluation.

target_entity.description: Entity to which the rule primarily applies. The referenced entity must exist in the manifest.

expression.description: Opaque domain/business expression describing the condition that must hold. The manifest schema does not define an expression language; expression validation is performed outside JSON Schema.

error_code.description: Standardized application error code emitted when the business rule fails.

error_message.description: Human-readable failure message associated with violation of the rule.

min_seconds.description: Minimum wait time in seconds between retries.

max_seconds.description: Maximum wait time cap in seconds.

name.description: Unique snake_case identifier for the step within its workflow.

action.description: Implementation-oriented semantic description of the operation performed by the step. This is not an executable command or formally typed API operation.

depends_on.description: Names of steps in the same workflow that must complete before this step can execute. References must be validated semantically outside JSON Schema and must not form cycles.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries permitted for this step.

retry_policy.description: Nested exponential retry behavior definition evaluated by the step runner.

timeout_seconds.description: Optional execution timeout limit in seconds for an individual step.
Overall workflow execution timeout limit in seconds.

claims_required.description: Optional claims required to exercise the authorized actions.
